question.zh: Pluribus 论文补充材料是否包含可制作完整回放的样例手牌？
question.en: Does the Pluribus supplementary material contain a sample hand suitable for a complete replay?

checks.result: The DOI resolves to the Science article. Candidate current and legacy supplementary endpoints returned a Cloudflare HTTP 403 response, so the filename and file contents were not treated as independently verified.

checks.target: Crossref, OpenAlex, Unpaywall, Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Europe PMC, DataCite, Zenodo, GitHub code search, Common Crawl and public web archives
checks.result: No independently retrievable complete hand-history file or mirror was found.

checks.target: Meta AI and Carnegie Mellon contemporary reports
checks.result: The reports corroborate the experiment and system, but no complete replayable hand history was located.

requiredForVerifiedReplay: ordered actions and bet sizes on every street

decision.zh: 当前没有取得满足完整回放要求的原始手牌记录，因此不生成 Pluribus 真实对局视频，也不把概念图伪装成样例手牌。后续只有在取得并核验补充 PDF 中的完整动作序列后才升级为回放。
decision.en: No raw hand record meeting the complete-replay requirements was obtained, so no verified Pluribus replay is generated and the conceptual explainer is not presented as a sample hand. Upgrade only after a complete action sequence from the supplement is obtained and verified.
